cases.question: Where can I get a Virginia Tech student parking permit?
cases.answer:
You can purchase a Virginia Tech student parking permit in two ways:

- **Online** through the Parking Services portal at virginiatech.t2hosted.com [1]
- **In person** at the Parking Services office, located at 505 Beamer Way [2]

When purchasing, students must present their **Hokie Passport** and **vehicle registration** [1].

stream.answer:
The undergraduate Computer Science major (BS) requires **123 credit hours** to graduate, according to the 2026-2027 catalog edition [1].

Note that this total is specific to that catalog edition. If you're on an earlier catalog year, your required total could differ — you can confirm your requirements via your checksheet or a DARS audit in HokieSpa [8].
